Bill.BriefDescription: Limiting the holding of more than one elected position.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to limiting the holding of more than one electedposition; and adding a new section to chapter 29A.20 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 29A.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) No city, county, or statewide elected official may hold morethan one elected position at a time except for voluntary work asdefined by this section. (2) An elected official holding two elected positions prior to theeffective date of this section may continue to serve in both positionsuntil the current terms of both offices have expired. After thecurrent terms of both offices have expired, such elected official mayonly hold one elected position at a time. (3) For the purposes of this section, "voluntary work" is definedas any city, county, or statewide elected position with compensation ofless than five hundred dollars per month.
